takes.situation: Inez finds the stamped card under the Fixer's saucer while clearing tables; the price comes after the proof.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Why's a Bureau card under your saucer? That's my name on it.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Read the stamp, Inez. The rest of your loan is paid.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: All of it? Put it away, people look. What's it cost me?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: A small thing. I telephone, you call Okafor over. About a minute.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Why would he come? You've seen us. What happens to him?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Nothing, if this goes right. He never sees us, and nobody hears.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Table six wants its bill. Trouble on the square, I'll warn you.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: You're with us now. When I telephone, call him off that door.

learned: Loan paid. Inez is with us.

takes.situation: Inez already knows something's changed because the Bureau's collector passed her, and she tries to pay the Fixer back.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: The Bureau's collector walked past me. It never walks past me.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: It won't stop for you again. The rest of your loan's paid.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Take my tips, then. I don't like owing. What's it for?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Keep them. When I telephone, call Okafor over. About a minute.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: He'd leave that door for... You know. What happens to him?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: If this goes right, nothing. He never sees us, Inez.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: If. All right. If trouble comes across the square, I'll warn you.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: So you're with us. I telephone, you call him off the door.

learned: Inez calls Okafor when we say.

takes.situation: The Fixer opens and the paid card arrives by tube; Inez says yes too fast, the Fixer makes her hear it, and she closes the deal.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Leave the cups, Inez. Your Bureau card's come down the tube.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Stamped paid. The whole loan? Yes. Whatever it is, yes. Not here.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Hear it first. When I telephone, call Okafor over from his door.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Why would I call... Oh. Who told you? Who else knows?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Only us, and it stops with us. He'd stay about a minute.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: What happens to him, then? He's never missed a shift.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Nothing, if this goes right. He never sees us. You're with us?

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Yes. I call him off. Trouble on the square, I'll warn you.

learned: Inez is with us, and watching.
